steps.note: The kit sends the X-Endgame-Session value Edge forwarded, with the app's own token. Both tokens are illustrative. The answer is cached for 30 seconds, never past expiresAt.
The kit's own endpoint (operation getCurrentUser). An end user of the app has kind "endUser" and role null. The address is illustrative.
In the front end the same person comes from useCurrentUser(), and signInUrl() / signUpUrl() send someone to the platform's pages. Store user.Id as an owner, never the e-mail.

body.title: The session is not valid
body.detail: The session is unknown, has expired, or is not a session for this app.

steps.note: Expired, unknown, or a session for another app.
The kit treats session_invalid as nobody signed in: CurrentUser is null, not an error.

variations.title: Nobody is signed in at an endpoint that needs a user

body.title: Sign in required
body.detail: This needs a signed-in user. Send the person to signInUrl.

steps.note: An API call gets a problem with signInUrl. A browser navigating (GET, Accept text/html) is redirected to sign in instead.
The web kit turns the 401 into NotSignedInError, carrying the signInUrl the server sent.

body.title: App token required
body.detail: The platform API needs the app's token (ENDGAME_APP_TOKEN) as a bearer token; this one is missing, unknown or superseded.

steps.note: Any /platform/v1 call with a missing, unknown or superseded token. A restart gives the app a fresh one.

output: The platform refused this app's token (ENDGAME_APP_TOKEN) on POST platform/v1/identity/resolve: The platform API needs the app's token (ENDGAME_APP_TOKEN) as a bearer token; this one is missing, unknown or superseded.. The token is injected when the app starts; a restarted app gets a fresh one.
steps.note: What the kit throws. The doubled full stop is in the kit's message as written: its template adds one after the platform's detail.

variations.title: The platform API is called through Edge's public side

body.title: Not found
body.detail: There is nothing at this address.

steps.note: Any request carrying X-Forwarded-Host or X-Original-Host came through Edge, and is answered as if nothing were here, before the token is even read.

variations.title: A handler needs a user but is not marked .RequireUser()

output: Unhandled exception. System.InvalidOperationException: Endgame app kit: 1 endpoint breaks the API contract (the platform builds the app's MCP tools from it):
- GET api/greeting: takes a non-nullable EndgameUser but is not marked .RequireUser(). Add .RequireUser(), or take EndgameUser? if signing in is optional.
steps.note: The app refuses to start. "Unhandled exception. System.InvalidOperationException:" is .NET's own prefix; the rest is the kit's message.
